test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Raj can build a house in 16 days by himself, while Suraj can do it in 12 days. Raj and Suraj work on alternate days. How many days would the house take to build if Raj starts working on the first day?
solution:
**Given:**

Raj can build a house = in 16 days

Suraj can build a house = in 12 days 

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total unit / No. of days

**Calculation:**

Let the total unit of work be L.C.M of 16 and 12 48 unit

( you can assume any number but for the sake of calculation, it is advised to take L.C.M of the given numbers) 

Now, Efficiency of Raj = Raj 1 day work = 48/16 = 3 

Also, Efficiency of Suraj = Suraj 1 day work = 48/12 = 4 

⇒ 2 days work of Raj and Suraj = 3 + 4 = 7 

Now in 6 pairs of days, they will do = 7 × 6 unit 

⇒ 12 days of work = 42 unit 

⇒ Remaining work = (48 - 42) = 6 unit 

As Raj works 1st. So, on the 13th day, 3 more units of work will be done by him 

Now, only ( 6 - 3 ) = 3 unit work is to be done, which will be done by Suraj, as they work alternatively 

⇒ 14th day work = 3/4 work is done . So, it takes 13 3/4 days to complete the whole work 

**Hence, the house would take 13 3/4 days to be built.**
